methods.name: YOLO + U-Net
methods.summary: A multi-model fusion method that first uses an improved YOLOv4 model (with DenseNet121 backbone and Focal Loss) to detect landslide locations, then applies an innovative expansion formula to the detection boxes to retain context, and finally uses an improved U-Net model (with ResNet50 backbone, CBAM attention, and pyramid pooling) for fine semantic segmentation within those boxes.
methods.verbatim: We propose a novel deep learning method for landslide identification, which combines YOLO + U-Net.
